title: Case 011: Shipment tracking has not updated after depot arrival

details.data: Entirely synthetic; English; fictional geography; all times UTC

context: Tracking stopped at the arrival scan, so the depot must locate the actual parcel rather than repeat the public tracking status.
initial_request: The tracker has not changed since early this morning. Could someone check whether the parcel is actually at the depot?
overview: The escalation snapshot comprises history events 001–002. Event 003 records the next agent action; the subsequent events provide the disclosed calibration follow-through. Facts learned later must not be used as if already known at escalation.

next_action.summary: Ask the destination depot for a physical scan and shipment location.

outcome: The depot supplies a fresh scan and verified location; delivery remains open.
boundaries: A physical depot scan is not proof of dispatch or delivery.

events.body: DL-011 last public scan: destination depot arrival at 06:15 UTC on 2026-02-12. No sort or route scan is visible. Our system does not currently confirm the storage position.
The tracker has not changed since early this morning. Could someone check whether the parcel is actually at the depot?
Please physically locate DL-011 and provide a new scan with its storage position. The existing arrival status alone does not answer Mera’s question.
At 09:45 UTC we found DL-011 in sort cage C-17 and scanned the label. The new location scan is now visible. It has not been allocated to a van yet.
